text: Transportation Services is requesting approval from the Toronto and East York Community Council to install on-street paid parking on Nelson Street. This request responds to direction from City Council to complete a review of all side streets in the vicinity of the King Street Transit Pilot in order to consider appropriate locations for on-street paid parking. Additionally, two commercial loading zones and one accessible loading zone are proposed to accommodate pick-up/drop-off and delivery activities. This staff report is a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Enacted the amendments set out in Attachment 1 to the report (June 15, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Infrastructure Management, Toronto and East York District.
